events.description: CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief reports that a Bin Ladin-sponsored terrorist operation has been planned but delayed a few months, while preparations for other attacks continue and suspicious activity persisted late the previous week.

CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief reports that an Usama Bin Ladin-sponsored terrorist operation had been planned but was delayed a few months. Preparations for other attacks continue. The text is heavily excised and gives no location.
Suspicious activity, apparently linked to preparations for further attacks, continued late in the week before 25 July 2001. The excised text does not say who was involved or where.

sources_cited: Senior Executive Intelligence Brief, 25 July 2001 (excised reporting)
key_claims: A terrorist operation sponsored by Usama Bin Ladin had been planned but was delayed by a few months, per CIA reporting in July 2001.
Preparations for other attacks remained underway and suspicious activity continued in the week before 25 July 2001.
The document is heavily redacted, so details of actors, targets and locations are not available in this chunk.
